reports.headline: The Winner Who Never Leaves
reports.body: {name} lost everything in one night at the storehouse {dir} of the village {dist} and says the same winner was still there when {they} left, laughing, fighting anyone who would put money down. Those who fight him never win. Those who walk out never get their money back.

reports.headline: Fights for Coin Under the Storehouse
reports.body: Travelers say there is a ring under the storehouse {dir} of here {dist}, and that every bout is a wager. {name} bet {their} boots and walked home barefoot through the snow, grinning, unable to stop.
